phases.name: Opening
phases.summary: It attacks from range with spits, then screeches.
phases.topMistake: A protection prayer left on during the screech.

phases.name: Larvae
phases.summary: Each screech now also launches one larva.
phases.topMistake: A larva left to land: it eats carrion and heals the boss.

phases.name: Slams
phases.summary: Melee slams join after each screech. This is where the kill is won.
phases.topMistake: Standing in the slam area and missing the punish hit.

phases.name: Melee only
phases.summary: It stops retreating and uses melee only. Four larvae come at once near 19% HP.

mechanics.name: Screech
mechanics.tell: A white aura around the boss, after 4 to 8 spits.
mechanics.do: Turn protection prayers OFF before it lands. Then attack: its Defence is halved.
mechanics.miss: Damage on each tick, up to three times, while a protection prayer is on.
mechanics.why: The screech punishes a protection prayer and opens a damage window: its Defence level drops from 200 to 100. A good time for a spec such as the Zaryte crossbow. A late prayer flick still cuts the total.

clips.label: Mechanics
clips.watch: The prayer goes off as the screech starts.

mechanics.name: Ranged spit
mechanics.tell: A green spit. The fight always opens with ranged.
mechanics.do: Pray Protect from Missiles. Step off the bile it leaves.
mechanics.miss: Poison, and bile on your tile and the two tiles next to it.
mechanics.why: Protect from Missiles blocks all of it. The style flips between ranged and magic after each screech, so count the spits: the screech comes after 4 to 8. A Serpentine helm with anti-venom+ makes you immune to the poison.

mechanics.name: Magic spit
mechanics.tell: A yellow spit, after a screech flips the style.
mechanics.do: Pray Protect from Magic. Step off the sticky bile.
mechanics.miss: Sticky bile drains Attack, Strength or Defence and delays your next attack by 1 tick.
mechanics.why: Protect from Magic blocks all of it. An inoculation bracelet makes you immune to the bile. Bile stays until carrion covers it or someone steps on it.

mechanics.name: Carrion
mechanics.tell: Shadows on random tiles with each screech.
mechanics.do: Stand 2 or more tiles from every shadow, or step onto an isolated shadow the tick after it lands.
mechanics.miss: A direct hit, or the splatter (up to 10).
mechanics.why: Carrion also clears bile. A small splatter is acceptable damage. A larva that reaches carrion eats it and heals the boss.

mechanics.name: Ur-maggot larvae
mechanics.tell: From 83% HP, each screech launches one larva: west first, then east and west in turn. Four at once near 19% HP.
mechanics.do: Shoot each larva with a standard bow before it lands. One shot kills it.
mechanics.miss: A landed larva eats carrion and heals the boss. If it reaches you, it chips 3 damage, then 1 more each tick.
mechanics.why: Firing the bow replaces your attack cooldown, so the shot costs no melee hit. With a 3- or 4-tick bow, two Dharok's attacks still fit before the first slam.

clips.label: In a kill
clips.watch: The bow comes out, one shot, back to melee.

mechanics.name: Slam
mechanics.tell: After a screech, it walks to the bone wall, lines up with your tile and slams a 3×4 area.
mechanics.do: Step to its east or west edge. Click the boss on the tick it extends its head.
mechanics.miss: You take the slam (35 with Protect from Melee) and lose the punish hit.
mechanics.why: A punish hit has no attack delay, +50% damage and better accuracy, most with crush. Only the first hit of a multi-hit weapon gets the bonus. The slam also throws 3 biles within 2 tiles.

clips.label: 4-tick weapon
clips.watch: Step back, then one hit lands with the slam.

clips.label: 5-tick weapon
clips.watch: The 5-tick attack fits beside the punish: no lost ticks.

clips.label: Weapon switch
clips.watch: The switch happens before the step back.

mechanics.name: Dharok's punish cycles
mechanics.tell: The same slam, fought with Dharok's greataxe at low HP.
mechanics.do: Use one 7-tick cycle: drag, drag, step back. Keep your HP at 1 to 15 during melee.
mechanics.miss: You lose punish hits. With HP high enough to survive a slam, Dharok's is worse than the other methods.
mechanics.why: An advanced method for the fastest kills. Keep HP at 20 to 30 outside melee, with low-heal food such as Guthix rest. The Wiki clips show three orders of the same cycle.

clips.label: Drag-drag-step
clips.watch: Two drags, then the step back.

clips.label: Drag-step-drag
clips.watch: The step back sits in the middle.

mechanics.name: Melee only
mechanics.tell: At about 305 HP (20%), it stops retreating and uses melee only.
mechanics.do: Keep Protect from Melee on. Ignore the screech: nothing is left to pray against.
mechanics.why: The spits stop here, so the screech no longer punishes a prayer. Keep punishing slams to the end.

styles.weakness: Crush (stab +172, slash +100, crush +45) and heavy ranged (heavy +43). Fire spells: elemental weakness to fire.
styles.detail: 1,500 HP, Defence 200. Ranged and magic spits hit up to 46; the melee slam up to about 55. Fire spells add a stacking 5 burn damage and lower its magic defence by 20 per stack. During slams its magic defence goes up from +150 to +400. Immune to poison and venom; not immune to thralls.

methods.name: Magic, then melee punishes
methods.summary: A harmonised Nightmare staff casting fire surge with a tome of fire, ahead of Tumeken's shadow. Twinflame staff is also good. Melee punishes from 65%. To confirm: the Wiki gives no rank; this order is a draft.

methods.name: Heavy ranged, then melee punishes
methods.summary: Ascension crossbows come second only to the harmonised Nightmare staff, but need the right dodge timing. Cheaper than magic.

methods.name: Budget heavy ranged
methods.summary: The hunters' sunlight crossbow is the budget pick and beats the twisted bow here. Other crossbows give longer kills.

methods.name: Dharok's punish
methods.summary: For skilled players chasing the fastest kills: a 7-tick drag-drag-stepback cycle at low HP. Worse than the others if you keep HP high enough to survive a slam.

gearPrinciples.principle: Punish with a slow, hard-hitting crush weapon.
gearPrinciples.why: Crush gets a large accuracy boost on punishes, and a punish has no attack delay. Examples: Obligator, Dharok's greataxe, Elder maul, a godsword.

gearPrinciples.principle: Bring a standard-ammo bow for the larvae.
gearPrinciples.why: One standard arrow kills a larva. Webweaver, Craw's or Venator bow, then Bow of Faerdhinen, composite or crystal bow. A charged bow avoids a quiver or cape switch problem.

gearPrinciples.principle: Use damage specs, not Defence-reducing specs.
gearPrinciples.why: Its Defence level comes back after each screech. If you do use a Defence-reducing spec, land it on a punish.
It needs 74 Prayer and 70 Defence. An amulet of blood fury is an optional switch.

combatAchievements.name: Maggot Squasher
combatAchievements.tip: Learn the screech first: prayer off, then attack.

combatAchievements.name: Trying to fit in
combatAchievements.task: Kill it using only weapons found in Vampyrium.

combatAchievements.name: Maggot Exterminator
combatAchievements.tip: Comes with the grind for the uniques.

combatAchievements.name: King-sized clobbering
combatAchievements.task: Kill it without missing a melee punish.
combatAchievements.tip: Click on the tick it extends its head, every slam.

combatAchievements.name: Cordoned Off
combatAchievements.task: Kill it without moving past the back row of tiles.
combatAchievements.tip: To confirm: a method that stays on the back row.

combatAchievements.name: Digging in
combatAchievements.task: Kill it while moving 40 tiles or fewer.
combatAchievements.tip: To confirm: a method that keeps the steps low.

combatAchievements.name: Camping the King
combatAchievements.task: Kill it 12 times without leaving the arena.
combatAchievements.tip: To confirm: a supply setup for 12 kills.

combatAchievements.name: Perfect Maggot King
combatAchievements.task: Kill it with no avoidable damage taken and with no heal on the boss.
combatAchievements.tip: Every larva shot before it lands; prayer off on every screech; no carrion hit.

combatAchievements.name: Maggot King Speed Chaser
combatAchievements.task: Get your first 5 kills within 9 minutes of entering the arena.
combatAchievements.tip: To confirm: the method that fits the time.

mistakes.mistake: A protection prayer left on during the screech.
mistakes.fix: Watch for the white aura and turn the prayer off before it lands.

mistakes.mistake: The bow does not fire after a melee cape switch.
mistakes.fix: Switch back to the quiver, or use a charged bow.

mistakes.mistake: The Venator bow's short range pulls you into a hazard.
mistakes.fix: Use it only when several larvae spawn.

mistakes.mistake: With an ascension crossbow, an attack delayed on each spit.
mistakes.fix: Learn the dodge timing, or use another method.

mistakes.mistake: With Dharok's, HP kept high enough to survive a slam.
mistakes.fix: Keep HP at 1 to 15 during melee, or use another method.

mistakes.mistake: The 4-tick step-back tile has bile on it.
mistakes.fix: Check the tile before the slam.

drops.note: Pet. On the take-eggs option, about 1/1,502.4 per kill.
